column1: # Canonical-route sweep of every registered Jibe tenant, 2026-07-28.
# Jibe's search payload carries no link of its own: "apply_url" is another
# vendor's application URL on 39.6% of the platform (818 distinct hosts across
# 414,311 postings). The posting's own page is "https://<board host>/<landing>/
# jobs/<slug>", which costs no extra request because jibeHost already computes
# the host and slug is already decoded. docs/dedupe-audit.md verified that route
# on four tenants; this file is the sweep of all 247.
# Method: for each tenant, GET https://<host>/api/jobs?limit=100&page=<n>, sample
# postings (page 1 for every tenant, plus randomly chosen deeper pages for the
# larger samples), and GET the canonical route for each. A probe PASSES only when
# the response is 200 AND the rendered page carries that posting's own title.
# Status alone is not enough: three boards answer 200 with their careers home
# page for a slug they do not serve, which is the silent-failure shape this
# Columns: key, board host, the board's live totalCount, probes, probes passed,
# and the route this adapter uses for the tenant. "fallback" means apply_url,
# and every one is listed in jibeApplyURLOnly with the reason.
# Totals: 247 tenants, 2,094 probes, 2,015 passed. 241 tenants on the canonical
# route covering 293,757 of 436,900 postings (67.2%); 6 on the fallback covering
